result.decision_rationale: Four of the five prior findings are resolved. The remaining blocker is evidence for WF11. Local Git confirms PR #2's published fifth review and transcript-only archive, but the supplied records stop before the final handoff comment and PR status update. A sanitized readback from the existing pilot is sufficient to close the gap.

executed_verification: Verified the snapshot HEAD and mission hash. All three controller gate receipts identify H, report exit zero and an unchanged worktree, and match the SHA-256 digests of their supplied logs.
The unit gate ran 194 tests with one opt-in skip. Both new enrollment-ownership regressions passed, along with the versioned-install, stop/resume, and cancellation tests.
The permissions gate recorded a real headless launch denying the ambient user allowance while permitting the enrolled helper. The control launch permitted the ambient command.
The separate live-smoke gate reached AWAITING_OWNER_REVIEW with real Opus and Astra invocations on a fixture repository using simulated GitHub.

Inspected PR #2's five archived requests in local Git. The fifth identifies bc4b300 and its fresh unit run. Git shows 17 transcript additions from c391eff to bc4b300 and four more from bc4b300 to b89fa6c.
inspected: Fixed mission, owner addenda, repository instructions, protocol, operating guide, feature diff, round-14 correction commit, developer report, prior ledger, and candidate-bound evidence.
Enrollment claim handling and regression tests, install and cancellation paths, workflow documentation links, Black Tentacles plan and start sequence, and WF01–WF12 acceptance report.
PR #2's locally available archive at b89fa6c, including the fifth review envelope and its GitHub publication identifier.
limitations: The foreground tool transcript is withheld. Its replacement points to the three candidate gate receipts. None contains the reported PR #2 handoff readback.
Review used read-only local inspection. The real GitHub handoff could not be queried from this snapshot.
required_gaps: R13-F2: a recorded readback identifying PR #2's final handoff comment and confirming the draft PR status section for H=bc4b300 and A=b89fa6c.
source_inspection_only: The protocol's operating-guide link resolves through docs/AGENT-REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md to the maintained guide and acceptance report.

The Black Tentacles plan retains BT01–BT36, native evidence and restoration requirements, with review after Phases 0–1 and at the complete Phase 4 candidate. The operating guide supplies the start sequence.

findings.actual: The acceptance report gives the handoff marker and timestamp and summarizes two commands. The supplied inputs contain neither their recorded output nor the receipt comment ID or URL. The archived URL ending in 7059721047 identifies the fifth Astra review, which preceded the archive and final handoff.
findings.blocking_rationale: The owner requires a demonstrated final handoff on a real draft PR. The archive and the simulated-GitHub smoke leave the final publication and PR body update unverified.
findings.expected: A reviewer can identify the published final receipt and verify the terminal PR state against the reviewed source and archive.
findings.requested_correction: Link WF11 to the existing final-status comment and include a sanitized, tool-recorded readback from PR #2 in the review evidence.
findings.requested_evidence: Provide the receipt comment ID or URL and the recorded fields showing an open draft, empty review requests, archive head b89fa6c, and the final PR status section naming reviewed source bc4b300 and archive b89fa6c. The existing pilot suffices.
findings.title: The final handoff on PR #2 still lacks a reviewable receipt
findings.trigger: Trace the WF11 pass from the fifth Astra review through the archive push to the subsequent handoff comment and PR body update.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: Enrollment resolves the state root before deriving persisted paths and checks existing claims before creating replacement state. The candidate-bound tests passed for lookup across working directories, refusal of a second enrollment, and preservation of claims when prior state cannot be established.
The added marker and timestamp identify what to look up. The independently inspectable records still end at the archive, and the requested final comment identifier and recorded readback are absent.
The corrected table matches all five archived candidate heads. It distinguishes four implementation invocations from the fifth report and fresh unit run on the transcript-only successor bc4b300.
The protocol now links to an existing workflow entry point. Its onward links reach the operating guide and acceptance report at H.

The guide describes immutable installation and explicit between-run activation. It requires operators to wait for the developer and runtime work and confirm cancellation before deleting files. This matches the implementation and the passing installation and cancellation tests.

summary.delivered_behavior: The candidate fixes cross-directory enrollment ownership, restores the operating-guide entry point, documents safe shutdown, and accounts for all five live pilot candidates. All three candidate gates passed.
remaining_owner_review: After WF11 is evidenced, decide whether to accept and install the controller and when to integrate the separately stacked PR #2.
